lines.say: A chicken lived eighteen fucking months without its head.
Colorado, 1945. The axe drops, and Mike the chicken gets right back up.
That blade missed his jugular and most of his brain stem, and a clot did the rest.
So they fed him with an eyedropper, took him on tour, and charged a quarter to look.
At his peak, this headless son of a bitch pulled in forty-five hundred dollars a month.
Then one night in a Phoenix motel, he started choking.
The syringe that cleared his throat was back at the last sideshow. Mike died.
You lose a good regular the same way, one forgotten follow-up at a time.
